scope: How the DriveRent car-rental and fleet application works, written from its source code. Each entry names the code it was verified against. Update this file when the application changes.

documents.title: What the DriveRent system can do
documents.text: Customers can browse vehicles, view vehicle details and daily rates, create reservations, pay for them online, view active rentals, reservation and payment history, cancel their own unpaid pending or confirmed reservations, and maintain their profile including driver's licence details and a verification photo. Administrators can additionally manage the vehicle inventory and images, cancel reservations, record vehicle handover and return, view payment history, record maintenance and mileage, complete vehicle condition assessments and review their results and 3D inspection, and view model-based service-need predictions when an accepted model is registered (none is accepted as of 2026-10-31).

documents.title: How to book a vehicle
keywords: do i need to sign a contract
how can i rent a car
how do i rent a vehicle
documents.text: Open Vehicles (/users/vehicles), choose a vehicle, and select Reserve to open the reservation form (/users/reservations/create). Pick a pickup date (today or any later date; there is no advance-booking limit) and a return date, and a colour if the vehicle offers several. Rentals must be at least 3 days (or the vehicle's own minimum, if longer) and at most 7 days; 8 to 21 days must be sent as a special-duration request, and longer rentals are not accepted. You must accept the rental agreement before submitting. The system checks that the vehicle is available and that no confirmed reservation, and no unpaid reservation still within its payment time, overlaps the dates. The new reservation is pending and holds the dates for 60 minutes: pay the rental total online from My Reservations (/users/reservations) within that time and it is confirmed automatically once the payment provider verifies the payment. If it is not paid within 60 minutes it expires and the dates are released, so you must make a new reservation. You can have at most 2 unpaid reservations waiting at once. The total is the stored daily rate multiplied by the number of rental days.

documents.title: Reservation statuses and who can change them
keywords: when will my booking be approved
how long until my booking is confirmed
how do i get my booking confirmed
documents.text: Reservation statuses are pending (awaiting payment), confirmed, cancelled, rejected, completed and expired. A pending reservation is confirmed automatically when the payment provider verifies full payment; administrators do not approve reservations by hand. A pending reservation that is not paid within 60 minutes becomes expired and stops holding its dates. An administrator can cancel an unpaid pending or confirmed reservation, records the vehicle handover during the rental period (only once it is paid), and records the return, which marks the reservation completed. A customer can cancel their own pending or confirmed reservation unless it has been paid or the vehicle has been handed over. Confirmed reservations, and pending ones still within their 60-minute payment time, block the vehicle for their dates; expired, cancelled, rejected and completed ones do not.

documents.title: How to cancel a reservation
keywords: change the date of my booking
documents.text: Open My Reservations (/users/reservations) and cancel a reservation that is still pending or confirmed. A reservation that has already been paid cannot be cancelled in the system: contact an administrator to arrange a refund. Completed, rejected, already-cancelled and handed-over reservations cannot be cancelled. There is no reschedule action: to change dates, cancel and create a new reservation, which is checked again for availability. The system stores no cancellation-fee rule, so ask the rental team about any fees.

documents.title: Extending or changing a rental
keywords: how do i extend my booking
add more days to my rental
documents.text: A reservation's dates cannot be changed or extended in the system: there is no reschedule, extend or edit-dates action. The rental agreement says any extension needs administrator approval and an updated agreement, so ask the rental team. To rent on other dates, create a new reservation (3 to 7 days, or up to 21 days as a special-duration request) and, if needed, cancel the old one from My Reservations (/users/reservations) while it is unpaid.

documents.title: How vehicle availability is decided
documents.text: A vehicle can be reserved for a period only when its listing status is available and no confirmed reservation, and no unpaid pending reservation still within its 60-minute payment time, overlaps the requested dates (periods are treated as pickup date inclusive, return date exclusive). An unpaid reservation stops blocking the dates as soon as its payment time runs out. Vehicle statuses are available, rented, maintenance and unavailable. The chat assistant checks a specific period when you give a pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD form plus a return date or a number of days.

documents.title: Payments and deposits
keywords: how to pay for my reservation
is the deposit included in the payment
how long do i have to pay
documents.text: Pay online from My Reservations (/users/reservations): choose Pay now on a pending reservation to open a Xendit checkout page, which offers the payment methods enabled there. The amount is the rental total; the security deposit is not part of the online payment. You have 60 minutes from making the reservation to pay, and the payment link expires at the same time; the reservation card shows the deadline. Choosing Pay again while a link is still open reuses it. Once the time runs out the reservation expires, its dates are released, and you must make a new reservation. The reservation is confirmed only when Xendit verifies the payment: a screenshot or receipt does not confirm it. If a payment arrives after the reservation was cancelled or expired, or a reservation is paid twice, the money is still recorded and an administrator reviews it to refund or rebook you. Past payments are under Payments (/users/payments). Refunds are arranged by an administrator; how the security deposit is collected and returned is handled by the rental team outside the system.

documents.title: Creating an account and signing in
documents.text: Create an account on the sign-up page (/auth/sign-up) with your full name, email address and a password of 8 to 72 characters; each email address can be registered once. Registration sends a verification link to your email address. You must open it (it works once and expires after 24 hours) before you can sign in at /auth/login; if it expired, sign in and choose 'Send a new verification link'. You can also sign up with Google, which needs no separate verification. If an account already uses your Google email, Google is not linked automatically: sign in with your password and link Google from your profile. Administrator accounts cannot be created by sign-up.

documents.title: Profile, driver's licence and verification
keywords: what do I need to rent
documents.text: The profile page (/users/profile) records your contact details, driver's licence number and licence expiry date, and a verification photo with your consent. The licence expiry date must be a valid date that has not passed. The verification photo is stored privately and is only viewable through the authenticated profile endpoint.

documents.text: To reserve a vehicle you need a signed-in, active customer account; administrator accounts cannot create reservations. The reservation form asks for the vehicle, a pickup date and a return date, and you must accept the rental agreement: the pickup date cannot be in the past, and the rental must be 3 to 7 days (up to 21 days as a special-duration request) and meet the vehicle's own minimum. The rental agreement says you must present a valid driver's licence and follow DriveRent's rental rules before pickup. Your profile (/users/profile) stores your driver's licence number and expiry date and a photo of you holding your licence, but the reservation form does not check the profile, so the system does not block a booking when no licence is saved, and the system stores no minimum-age rule or other document requirement, so ask the rental team what else they check at pickup.

documents.title: How rental prices and totals are calculated
keywords: is the deposit included in the total
documents.text: A reservation's total is the vehicle's daily rate multiplied by the number of rental days, counted from the pickup date up to but not including the return date. Rentals are charged by the full day, with no hourly rate, and run 3 to 7 days, or up to 21 days as a special-duration request. The system stores no discounts, promotions, free days, taxes or extra fees, and the listed security deposit is shown separately and is not added to the total or to the online payment. Ask the rental team about any charges they handle outside the system. No late-return fee or penalty is stored either.

documents.title: What the assistant can see for customers and administrators
keywords: what data can the chatbot see
documents.text: Your role is taken from your signed-in account on the server, never from what you type. Customers' chat can use public vehicle listings and that customer's own bookings only. Administrators' chat can also use fleet status counts, maintenance records and model-based service-need predictions. The assistant never returns other customers' bookings or personal details, passwords, tokens or API keys, and it cannot create, change or delete records.

documents.title: Common error messages and what to do
documents.text: 'Authentication is required' (401): your session expired; sign in again. 'Verify your email address before signing in' (403): open the verification link in your email, or choose 'Send a new verification link'. 'Too many sign-in attempts' (429): wait the stated number of minutes or reset your password. 'Administrator access is required' (403): the page or action is for administrators only. 'This vehicle is already reserved for part or all of those dates' or 'not available for those dates' (409): choose other dates or another vehicle. 'You already have unpaid reservations waiting for payment' (409): pay for or cancel one of your 2 unpaid reservations first. 'The time to pay for this reservation has run out' (409): the 60-minute payment time ended and the dates were released; make a new reservation. 'The selected dates do not meet this vehicle's minimum rental duration' (422): extend the period. 'Enter a message of up to 4,000 characters' (422): shorten the chat message. 'The local AI chat service is unavailable right now' (503): the Python AI service is not running or not reachable; an administrator should start it (python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8001) and check AI_SERVICE_API_URL and AI_SERVICE_API_KEY.

documents.title: Managing vehicles (administrators)
documents.text: Administrators manage the inventory at /admin/vehicles: create a vehicle (/admin/vehicles/create), edit its details, daily rate, deposit, minimum rental duration, category and status, upload or delete images, or delete the vehicle. Setting status to maintenance or unavailable prevents new reservations.

documents.title: Maintenance records, vehicle assessments and 3D inspection (administrators)
documents.text: Maintenance Records (/admin/maintenance/records) logs services with type, date, cost, status and odometer, and updates vehicle mileage. Predictive Maintenance (/admin/maintenance/predictions) starts by listing the fleet vehicles. Select a vehicle and complete its condition assessment across eight categories: engine, battery and electrical, brakes, transmission, suspension and steering, tires and wheels, cooling system, and air conditioning. After the assessment is submitted, the results page shows the overall condition, condition-based findings for each category, assessment history and a 3D inspection of the vehicle. A machine learning prediction appears only for a category with an accepted model. To record a component inspection or a service interval, open a vehicle's results and use the Component records tab. Model training and the model registry are on Model Management (/admin/maintenance/model-management).

documents.title: What the maintenance prediction means and its limits
documents.text: A maintenance prediction is shown only when a model has passed the service's acceptance gate (group-held-out evaluation, at least the baseline, calibrated probabilities). The candidate is a service-need model: for a vehicle's current odometer, body type and fuel type it estimates the probability that each service item (air filter, brake fluid, transmission fluid and so on) would be performed at a workshop visit. It was trained on 1,139 workshop visits for four car models (Honda Jazz, Amaze, City; Toyota Fortuner) and tested on a car model it had not seen. As of 2026-10-31 no version has passed the gate (best held-out macro F1 0.54 to 0.73 against a 0.60 minimum and the baseline), so predictions are reported as unavailable with that reason. It is a scheduled-service need, not a detected fault or a failure forecast, and never gives failure dates. Always confirm by inspection and the manufacturer schedule.

documents.title: Rule-based service due estimates
documents.text: The maintenance overview also computes rule-based due estimates: a vehicle is approaching when its baseline 180-day interval since the last completed service ends within 30 days, and overdue when 5,000 km have been driven since the last recorded service odometer, a recorded next-maintenance date has passed, or 180 days have passed. Vehicles with no completed service history are marked insufficient. These are schedule estimates, not mechanical assessments; check the manufacturer schedule.

documents.title: Approving and managing reservations (administrators)
keywords: how do i approve a reservation
how do i mark a reservation as completed
how do i complete a reservation
documents.text: Administrators see reservations at Reservations (/admin/reservations), with past ones under Reservation History (/admin/reservations/history) and payments under Payment History (/admin/payments). Reservations are confirmed automatically by a verified payment, not by hand. An administrator can cancel an unpaid pending or confirmed reservation (a paid one cannot be cancelled in the system; its refund is arranged outside it), record the vehicle handover during the rental period once it is paid, and record the return, which marks the reservation completed. Dates and prices cannot be edited.

documents.title: Changing or resetting a password
keywords: how do I change my password
documents.text: Choose 'Forgot password?' on the sign-in page (/auth/login), enter your email address, and open the link we email you within 1 hour to choose a new password of 8 to 72 characters. The link works once, and saving a new password signs you out on every device. Accounts created with Google can use the same steps to set a first password. There is no separate change-password form while signed in; use the same reset link. After 5 wrong passwords, sign-in for that account is paused for 15 minutes (longer if it happens again); resetting the password is the quickest way back in.

documents.title: Pickup and return of a rental
keywords: how do I return the car
where do I pick up the car
can someone else return the car
documents.text: Each reservation records a pickup date and a return date; the return date is not counted as a rental day, and the rental agreement requires the vehicle back on the stated return date. An administrator records the handover during the rental period, and only after the reservation is paid; when the vehicle comes back, the administrator records the return and the reservation is marked completed. The system stores no pickup or return times, no pickup location, and no fuel, cleaning or handover rules, so confirm those with the rental team.
